'''Sunbleak Island''' is an island in the [[Shrouded Ocean]]. Mooring at the island requires 72 [[Sailing]]{{Boostable|no}} as well as an [[adamant helm]] to traverse the surrounding [[tangled kelp]].

The island is home to the [[Sunbleak Cave]], 14 [[ironwood tree]]s, 6 [[Tortoise (Sunbleak Island)|tortoises]], and three buildable utilities: a [[bank chest]], [[cooking pot]], and [[water pump]]. 

A [[lockbox (Sunbleak Island)|lockbox]] is located west of the cave entrance. It can be opened using the [[small key (Laguna Aurorae)]] to obtain the [[dragon helm schematic]].

==Transportation==
The island can only be reached by sailing there in a boat. 

* Use a [[Necklace of passage]], a [[Slayer ring]], or a [[Slayer ring (eternal)]] to teleport to [[Wyrmscraig]], summon your boat, and sail north-west.

*Use the [[sailors' amulet]] to teleport to [[Deepfin Point]], summon your boat, and sail south-east.

== Item Spawns==
There are two [[Item spawn|item spawns]] on the island.
* A [[knife]] to the south-west of the island
* A [[rope]] to the north-east of the island

== Woodcutting ==
The island contains the only accessible non-farmed [[ironwood tree]]s. [[Ironwood logs]] and [[Ironwood plank|planks]] are used in [[shipbuilding]] for various [[facilities]], [[core boat parts]], [[ironwood repair kit]]s, as well for building [[Buildable bank chests|bank chests]] on certain islands. 

To save on time used banking elsewhere, it is advisable to build the bank chest if you plan on cutting the trees there.

If you cannot build a bank chest, the [[bank boat]] is fairly nearby to the north. A [[log basket]] can also roughly halve the amount of banking trips required.
